body:
Done. All changes verified, `npx tsc --noEmit` clean.

**ProjectGrid.tsx**
- Line 42: `checkout my other open-source projects on Github:` → `Check out my other open-source projects on GitHub:` (capitalized, two words, GitHub capitalization)
- No `grid-bg` class present — nothing to remove.

**ProjectCard.tsx** — full rewrite, removed:
- `useRef`, `useState` imports (no longer needed)
- `useMotionValue`, `useSpring`, `useTransform` imports (tilt machinery)
- `x`, `y`, `mouseXSpring`, `mouseYSpring`, `rotateX`, `rotateY` declarations
- `handleMouseMove`, `handleMouseLeave` functions
- `onMouseMove`, `onMouseEnter`, `onMouseLeave` handlers
- `isHovered` state
- `style={{ rotateX, rotateY, transformStyle: 'preserve-3d' }}` on outer div
- `style={{ transform: 'translateZ(0)' }}` on card container
- `style={{ transform: 'translateZ(30px)' }}` on content div
- `motion.div` border glow overlay (the one with `animate={{ opacity: isHovered ? 1 : 0 }}`)

Added/kept:
- CSS hover: `hover:border-accent/50` on card container (replaces motion border glow)
- Image: `loading="lazy"`, `width="400"`, `height="300"` (matches aspect-[4/3])
- Image: `onError={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.display = 'none'; }}`
- Reduced-motion guard: `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches` — if true, entrance animation props are empty (card renders visible immediately, no flash)
- Kept: `group-hover:scale-105` on image, `group-hover:text-accent` on title, gradient overlay on hover, featured badge, all content/links
